primitives.name: Mechanical Code Refinement Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: --description: Lint + typecheck, fix mechanical only --Run lint and typecheck.
primitives.assumptions: All mechanical issues are decidable and finite in scope.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When M ⊆ F, mechanical refinement is complete.

layer2.mapping: Mechanical fixes map to state transitions in GSE's deterministic automaton, where each fix corresponds to an atomic update in the codebase's structural state vector.

primitives.name: Logic Change Review Trigger
primitives.verbatim_quote: For anything that changes logic or types, list it for review instead of fixing.
primitives.assumptions: Logic changes are non-mechanical and require semantic validation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When L = 1, R → ∞, triggering human-in-the-loop process.

layer2.mapping: Logic change detection maps to a kernel function in GSI's Bayesian model, where L triggers a prior update in the correctness belief distribution.
layer2.telemetry: Number of logic-change review requests per commit

primitives.name: Validation Pipeline Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: After applying, run `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npx vitest run <affected test files>` and report the results; a change is not done until they pass.
primitives.assumptions: Pipeline stages are sequential and cumulative.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ∀v ∈ V, P(v) = true, then change is accepted.

layer2.mapping: Validation pipeline mirrors a compositional proof system in GSI, where each stage (typecheck, lint, tests) contributes a constraint to the overall correctness assertion.
